create_layer_elementwise: create an Elementwise layer that applies an activation function elementwise to a NamedArray input
create_layer_softmax: create a Softmax layer that applies softmax normalization along specified named axes
create_layer_cast_dtype: create a CastToDType layer that casts input arrays to a specified JAX dtype
test_layer_elementwise: test the Elementwise layer with a NamedArray input and verify elementwise function application
test_layer_softmax: test the Softmax layer with a NamedArray input and verify normalization along given axes
